title: Embedded Stacks comparison
statement: For prime ell, finite embedded E, a generator pi of its maximal ideal, and a Noetherian scheme X, an arbitrary derived complex K of continuous integral-coefficient modules is bounded constructible if and only if its restriction along the canonical scalar map satisfies the Stacks constant-coefficient criterion of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients].

proof.text: First lift the embedded finite field to ULift in the scheme universe, and transport along its canonical ring equivalence; the published coefficient theorems bind the field and scheme in the same universe. Identify embedded and spectral integer rings using uniqueness of the extending absolute value, and identify the residue ideals because the specified uniformizers generate the maximal ideal. Constant sheafification and continuous function sheaves carry these identifications to ring sheaves, preserving scalar maps and reductions.

Transport the first clause of the Stacks integral-model theorem across these ring isomorphisms and the section-action and small-site equivalences. Derived scalar restriction and extension commute with the identifications; completeness, constructible cohomology and finite Tor intervals are preserved. This gives precisely the embedded criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem embeddedIntegral_stacks_comparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E))) :
    constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X K ↔
      IntegralModelsEmbedded.stacksConstructible ℓ E π X
        ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K)
